a: Hurehana — in, nechbesha — la. hu haddin afillu nechbesha. umaase shehaya, kach haya.

Ikka deamri, amar rava: af anan name tenena: heid rabbi yose hakkohen verabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav al bat yisrael shehurehana beashkelon, verichakuha bene mishpachtah, veedeha meidim aleha shello nistera veshello nitmaa, veamru chachamim: im attem maaminim shehurehana — haaminu shello nistera veshello nitmaa, veim en attem maaminim shello nistera veshello nitmaa — al taaminu shehurehana.
Veha ashkelon, deal yede mamon hava, vetama deedim meidin otah, ha en edim meidin otah — la. may lav: la shena hurehana, vela shena nechbesha! la, hurehana shane.
Ikka derame la mirma, tenan: al yede mamon mutteret levalah, ureminhu: heid rabbi yose kulei. veha ashkelon, deal yede mamon, vekatane: tama deedim meidim otah, ha en edim meidin otah la!
Umeshanne, amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak, la kashya: kan sheyyad yisrael takkifa al ummot haolam, kan sheyyad ummot haolam takkifa al atzman.

Al yede nefashot asura vechulei. amar rav: kegon neshe gannave. velevi amar: kegon ishto shel ben donay. amar chizkiyya: vehu shennigmar dinan lahariga, verabbi yochanan amar: af al pi shello nigmar dinan lahariga.
Mishna ir shekkevashuha karkom — kol kohanot shennimtzeu betochah pesulot. veim yesh lahen edim, afillu eved, afillu shifcha — hare ellu neemanin. veen neeman adam al yede atzmo.
Gemara ureminhu: balleshet shebbaa lair, bishat shalom — chaviyyot petuchot asurot, setumot muttarot. bishat milchama — ellu veellu muttarot, lefi sheen penay lenassech.
Amar rav mari: livol yesh penay, lenassech en penay. rabbi yitzchak bar elazar mishshemeh dechizkiyya amar: kan becharkom shel otah malchut, kan becharkom shel malchut acheret.

Shel otah malchut name, i efshar dela arak chad minnayyhu. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: keshemmishmarot root zo et zo. i efshar dela nayyma pureta! amar rabbi levi: kegon dimhaddar la lemata shushilta vechalba ugevoza vaavoza.

Amar rabbi abba bar zavda: peligi ba rabbi yehuda nesia verabbanan. chad amar: kan becharkom shel otah malchut, kan becharkom shel malchut acheret, vela kashya leh vela midde. vechad kashya leh kol hane, umeshanne: kegon dimhaddar leh lemata shushilta vechalba ugevoza vaavoza.
Amar rav idi bar avin amar rabbi yitzchak bar ashyan: im yesh sham machboa achat — matztzelet al hakkohanot kullan.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: enah machzeket ella achat mahu? mi amrinan kol chada vachada hayeynu ha, o dilma la amrinan?
Umay shena mishshene shevilin, echad tame veechad tahor. vehalach beechad mehen veasa teharot, uva chavero vehalach bashsheni veasa teharot,
Rabbi yehuda omer: im nishal ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo — tehorot. shenehem keachat — temeot. rabbi yosi omer: ben kach uven kach temein.

Veamar rava, veittema rabbi yochanan: bevat achat — divre hakkol: temein. beze achar ze — divre hakkol: tehorim. lo nechleku ella beva lishshael alav veal chavero: mar medamme leh livvat achat, umar medamme leh levaze achar ze. vehacha name, kevan deshare lehu lechullehu — kevat achat dame!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam vadday ikka tumea, hacha mi yemar deittammay.
Bae rav ashe, amra: lo nechbeti velo nitmeti, mahu? mi amrinan:
b: Ma li leshakker. o dilma la amrinan?

Umay shena mehahu maase, dehahu gavra deogar leh chamara lechavreh, amar leh: la tezil beorcha dinhar pekod deikka mayya, zil beorcha denaresh delekka mayya, vaazal ihu beorcha dinhar pekod umit chamara.

Ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: in, beorcha dinhar pekod azali, mihu la havo mayya. amar rabba: "ma li leshakker". i bae, amar leh: beorcha denaresh azali. vaamar leh abbaye: "ma li leshakker" bimkom edim la amrinan.
Hachi hasheta?! hatam vadday ikka edim deikka mayya. hacha, vadday ittammay? chashasha hu, uvimkom chashasha — amrinan.
Im yesh edim, afillu eved vaafillu shifcha neemanin. vaafillu shifcha dida mehemna? ureminhi: lo tityayched immo ella al pi edim.
Vaafillu al pi eved veal pi shifcha. chutz mishshifchatah, mippene shellibbah gas beshifchatah! amar rav pappe: bishvuya hekellu.
Rav pappa amar: ha beshifcha dida, ha beshifcha dideh.
Veshifcha dida la mehemna? ha katane: en adam meid al atzmo, ha shifcha dida mehemna! shifchatah name keatzmah dame.
Rav ashe amar: ha veha beshifcha dida, veshifcha michza chazya veshatka. hatam dishtikatah mattiratah — la mehemna. hacha dishtikatah osartah — mehemna.
Hasheta name atya umeshakkera! tarte la avda.

Ki ha demari bar isak, veamri la chana bar isak, ata leh acha mibbe chozaa. amar leh: pelog li benichse deabba! amar leh: la yadana lach. ata lekammeh derav chisda. amar leh: shappir kaamar lach, dichtiv: "vayyakker yosef et echav vehem lo hikkiruhu", melammed sheyyatza belo chatimat zakan uva bachatimat zakan.

Amar leh: zil ayyti sahade daachu at. amar leh: it li sahade, umistefu minneh, degavra allama hu. amar leh ledideh: zil ayytinhu at delav achuch hu. amar leh: dina hachi? hammotzi mechavero alav haraya! amar leh: hachi daenna lach ulechullehu allame chavrach. hasheta name atu umeshakkeri! tarte la avdi.

Lema ketannae: zo edut — ish veishsha, tinok vetinoket, aviha veimmah, veachiha vaachotah. aval lo benah uvittah, lo avdah veshifchatah. vetanya iddach: hakkol neemanin lehaid, chutz mehemenna uvalah.
Derav pappe uderav ashe tannae hi. derav pappa [mi] lema tannae hi.
Amar lecha rav pappa: ki tanya hahi, bimsicha lefi tummah.

Ki ha dechi ata rav dimi, amar: rav chanan kartignaa mishtae: maase ba lifne rabbi yehoshua ben levi, veamri la rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishtae: maase ba lifne rabbi beadam echad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo, veamar: ani veimmi nishbinu leven haggoyim. yatzati lishov mayim — dati al immi, lelakket etzim — dati al immi. vehissiah rabbi lichhunna al piv.
Mishna amar rabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav: hammaon hazze! lo zaza yadah mittoch yadi mishshaa shennichnesu goyim lirushalayim vead sheyyatzu. amru lo: en adam meid al atzmo.
Gemara tana: veaf al pi chen, yiched lah bayit bachatzero, ucheshehi yotza — yotza berosh baneha, ucheshehi nichneset — nichneset besof baneha.
Bae abbaye: mahu laasot bigrusha ken? hatam hu, devishvuya hekellu, aval hacha — la, o dilma la shena?
Ta shema, detanya: hamegaresh et ishto — lo tinnase bishchunato.

a: Veim haya kohen — lo tadur immo bemavoy. im haya kefar katan — ze haya maase veamru: kefar katan niddon kishchuna.
Mi nidche mippene mi? ta shema, detanya: hi nidchet mippanav, veen hu nidche mippaneha. veim hayta chatzer shellah — hu nidche mippaneha.

Ibbaya lehu: hayta chatzer shel shenehem, mahu? ta shema: hi nidchet mippanav. bemay askinan? ilema bechatzer shello, peshita! veella bechatzer shellah, vehatanya: im hayta chatzer shellah — hu nidche mippaneha. ella lav ki hay gavvna, dilma daagir megar.
May have ala? ta shema: "hinne Adonai metaltelcha taltela gaver", veamar rav: tiltula degavra kashe middeitteta.

Tanu rabbanan: lava hemenna benichse aviha — enah nifraat ella al yede acher. amar rav sheshet: vei atu lekamman ledina, la mizdakkinan lehu. rav pappa amar: shammote meshammetinan lehu. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: naggode name menaggedinan lehu. amar rav nachman: tana beevel rabbati: bamme devarim amurim — shennitgarsha min hannissuin, aval keshennitgarsha min haerusin, nifraat al yede atzmah — sheen libbo gas bah.

Hahu arus vaarusato daato lekammeh derava. yetev rav adda bar matna kammeh. oki rava shelucha bentayyhu. amar leh rav adda bar matna, vehaamar rav nachman: tana beevel rabbati kulei. amar leh: ka chazena d(ka) gayysi bahadade.

Ikka deamri: la oki rava shaliach bentayyhu. amar leh rav adda bar matna: noykevm mar shelucha bentayyhu, amar leh: veha [amar] rav nachman tana beevel rabbati kulei. amar leh: hane mille, hecha dela gayysi bahadade, aval hane — ka chazena lehu degayysi bahadade.
Mishna veellu neemanin lehaid begodlan ma sherau bekotnan. neeman adam lomar: "ze ketav yado shel abba", veze ketav yado shel rabbi", veze ketav yado shel achi".

"Zachur hayiti biflonit sheyyatza behinuma veroshah parua", veshehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer litbol, leechol bitruma". veshehaya cholek immanu al haggoren". vehammakom hazze bet happeras". vead kan hayinu bain bashshabbat".
Aval en adam neeman lomar "derech haya lifloni bammakom hazze", "maamad umisped haya lifloni bammakom hazze".
Gemara amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: vehu sheyyesh gadol immo.
Utzericha. dei ashmeinan aviv — mishshum dishchiach gabbeh, aval rabbo — la. vei ashmeinan rabbo, mishshum deit leh emteh derabbeh, aval aviv — la.

Vei ashmeinan hane tarte: aviv — dishchiach gabbeh, verabbo — deit leh emteh, aval achiv delet leh la ha vela ha — ema la, ka mashma lan: kevan dekiyyum shetarot midderabbanan, hemnuhu rabbanan bidrabbanan.
"Zachur hayiti biflonit sheyyatza behinuma veroshah parua". may tama — kevan derov nashim betulot nissaot, gilluy milleta bealma hu.

Veshehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer litbol, leechol bitruma". vedilma eved kohen hu? mesayyay leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asur leadam sheyyelammed et avdo tora.
Vela? vehatanya: lava hemennu rabbo, o sheasao rabbo
b: Appotroppos, o shehinniach tefillin bifne rabbo, o shekkara shelosha pesukim bevet hakkeneset — hare ze lo yatza lecherut. hatam deikkeri eved middato. ki kaamrinan — deka naheg beh minhag banim.

Litbol leechol bitruma. bitruma derabbanan. veshehaya cholek immanu al haggoren. vedilma eved kohen hu? tenan keman deamar en cholkin teruma leeved ella im ken rabbo immo. detanya: en cholkin teruma leeved ella im ken rabbo immo, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: yachol hu sheyyomar: im kohen ani — tenu li bishvil atzmi, veim eved kohen ani — tenu li bishvil rabbi.
Bimkomo shel rabbi yehuda hayu maalin mitteruma leyuchasin. bimkomo shel rabbi yose lo hayu maalin mitteruma leyuchasin.

Tanya, amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose: miyyamay lo headti. paam achat headti veheelu eved lakkehunna al pi. heelu salka datach?! hasheta uma behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadam, tzaddikim atzmam lo kol shekken!
Ella: bikkeshu lehaalot eved lakkehunna al pi. chaza beatreh derabbi yose, vaazal veashed beatreh derabbi yehuda.

Veshehammakom hazze bet happeras hu. may tama? bet happeras derabbanan. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: menappeach adam bet happeras veholech. verav yehuda bar amme mishshemeh derav yehuda amar: bet happeras shenniddash — tahor. may tama — i efshar leetzem kisora shello niddash baregel.
Vead kan hayinu bain bashshabbat. kasavar: techumin derabbanan.
Veen neeman lomar "derech haya lifloni bammakom hazze", "maamad umisped haya lifloni bammakom hazze". may tama — appoke mamona la mappekinan.
Tanu rabbanan: neeman hattinok lomar, kach amar li abba: "mishpacha zo tehora", "mishpacha zo temea". tehora utemea salka datach?! ella "mishpacha zo keshera", umishpacha zo pesula".

Vesheachalnu biktzatza shel bat peloni lifloni", veshehayinu molichim challa umattanot lifloni kohen". al yede atzmo, aval lo al yede acher. vechullan, im haya goy venitgayyer, eved venishtachrer — en neemanim. veen neeman lomar "derech haya lifloni bammakom hazze", "maamad umisped haya lifloni bammakom hazze". rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: neemanim.
Rabbi yochanan ben beroka aheyay? illema assefa: appoke mamona hu! ella aresha. vechullam, im haya goy venitgayyer, eved venishtachrer — en neemanin. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: neemanin.
Bemay kamippalgi? tanna kamma savar: kevan degoy hu, la hava dayek. verabbi yochanan ben beroka savar: kevan dedateh leiggayyore, medak hava dayek.

May "ketzatza"? detanu rabbanan: ketzad ketzatza? echad min haachin shennasa ishsha sheenah hogenet lo — bain bene mishpacha umeviin chavit melea perot veshovrin otah beemtza rechava, veomrim: achenu bet yisrael shimu! achinu peloni nasa ishsha sheenah hogenet lo, umityayrim anu shemma yitarev zaro bezarenu. bou ukechu lachem dugema ledorot, shello yitarev zaro bezarenu. vezo hi ketzatza shehattinok neeman lehaid aleha.
Hadaran alach haishsha shennitarmela

a: Ellu nearot sheyyesh lahen kenas: habba al hammamzeret veal hannetina veal hakkutit, habba al haggiyyoret veal hashshevuya veal hashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeyru veshennishtachreru, pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veyom echad.
Habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal hannidda — yesh lahem kenas, af al pi shehen behikkaret — en bahen mitat bet din.
Gemara hane nearot, pesulot it lehu kenas, kesherot la?! hachi kaamar: ellu nearot pesulot sheyyesh lahem kenas — habba al hammamzeret veal hannetina veal hakkutit.
Naara in, ketanna la. man tanna?

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: rabbi meir hi. detanya: ketanna mibbat yom echad vead shettavi shete searot — yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas. umishshettavi shete searot vead shettivgar — yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher. divre rabbi meir. shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol makom sheyyesh mecher — en kenas, vechol makom sheyyesh kenas — en mecher.
Vachachamim omrim: ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad vead shettivgar — yesh lah kenas. kenas in, mecher la?! ema:
b: Af kenas bimkom mecher.

Vehane bene kenasa ninhu? veammay? ikkeri kan: "velo tihye leishsha", ishsha haruya lo! amar resh lakish: "naara", "naara", "hannaara". chad legufeh, vechad leetoye chayyayve lavin, vechad leetoye chayyayve charetot.
Rav pappa amar: "betula", "betulot", "habbetulot". chad legufeh, vechad leetoye chayyayve lavin, vechad leetoye chayyayve charetot.
Verav pappa may tama la amar keresh lakish? hahu mibbee leh lechidabbaye. deamar abbaye: ba aleha umeta — patur, shenneemar: "venatan laavi hannaara". laavi naara, velo laavi meta.

Veresh lakish may tama la amar kerav pappa? hahu mibbee leh ligzera shava. detanya: "kesef yishkol kemohar habbetulot", sheyyehe ze kemohar habbetulot, umohar habbetulot kaze. veresh lakish name, mibbee leh lechidabbaye. verav pappa name, mibbee leh ligzera shava!

Ella: shitta kerae ketivi? "naara" "naara" "hannaara". "betula" "betulot" "habbetulot", tere legufayyhu, chad lechidabbaye, vechad ligzera shava. iyyaytaru leh tere. chad — leetoye chayyayve lavin, vechad — leetoye chayyayve charetot.
Uleappoke mehay tanna, detanya: "velo tihye leishsha", shimon hattimni omer: ishsha sheyyesh bah havaya. rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: ishsha haruya lekayyeymah.
May benayyhu? amar rabbi zera: mamzeret unetina ikka benayyhu. leman deamar yesh bah havaya, ha name yesh bah havaya. leman deamar reuya lekayyeymah, ha enah reuya lekayyeymah.

Ulerabbi akiva deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin, may benayyhu! ikka benayyhu almana lechohen gadol, kerabbi simay, detanya: rabbi simay omer: min hakkol ose rabbi akiva mamzerin, chutz mealmana lechohen gadol. shehare amra tora: "lo yikkach ... velo yechallel" — chillulin hu ose, veen ose mamzerin.
Ulerabbi yeshevav, deamar: bou venitzvach al akiva ben yosef, shehaya omer: kol sheen lo bia beyisrael — havvalad mamzer. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu

a: Chayyayve ase, mitzri vaadomi.
Hanicha lerabbi yeshevav, i leappoke mittama derabbi simay kaate — shappir. ella i tama denafsheh kaamar, kol sheen lo bia beyisrael havvalad mamzer — vaafillu chayyayve ase! may benayyhu?
Ikka benayyhu beula lechohen gadol. umay shena? dehave leh ase sheeno shave bakkol.
Amar rav chisda: hakkol modim beva al hannidda shemmeshallem kenas. leman deamar yesh bah havaya — ha name yesh bah havaya. leman deamar reuya lekayyeymah — ha name reuya lekayyeymah.

Uleappoke midderabbi nechuneya ben hakkana. detanya: rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana haya ose et yom hakkippurim kashshabbat letashlumin. ma shabbat — mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin, af yom hakkippurim — mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin.

May tama derabbi nechuneya ben hakkana? amar abbaye: neemar "ason" bide adam. veneemar "ason" bide shamayim. ma "ason" haamur bide adam — patur min hattashlumin, af "ason" haamur bide shamayim — patur min hattashlumin.

Matkef la rav adda bar ahava: mimmay dechi ka mazhar lehu yaakov livneh, al tzinnim ufachim devide shamayim ninhu? dilma al arya vegannave devide adam ninhu?! attu yaakov aha azhar, aha la azhar? yaakov al kol mille azhar.

Vetzinnim pachim bide shamayim ninhu? vehatanya: hakkol bide shamayim chutz mitztzinnim pachim, shenneemar: "tzinnim pachim bederech ikkesh shomer nafsho yirchak mehem"! vetu arya vegannave bide adam ninhu? vehaamar rav yosef vechen tane rabbi chiyyay: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, af al pi shebbatlu sanhedrin, arba mitot lo batlu. lo batlu?! ha batlu lehu! ella:
b: Din arba mitot lo batlu. mi shennitchayyev sekila — o nofel min haggag, o chayya dorasto. umi shennitchayyev serefa — o nofel bidleka, o nachash makkisho. umi shennitchayyev hariga — o nimsar lammalchut, o listim bain alav. umi shennitchayyev chenek — o tovea bannahar, o met bisronche?! ella, efoch: arya vegannave bide shamayim, tzinnim ufachim bide adam.

Rava amar, tama derabbi nechuneya ben hakkana mehacha: "veim haelem yalimu am haaretz et enehem min haish hahu betitto mizzaro lammolech. vesamti ani et panay baish hahu uvemishpachto vehichratti oto", amra tora: karet shelli kemita shellachem, ma mita shellachem — patur min hattashlumin. af karet shelli — patur min hattashlumin.
May ikka ben rava leabbaye? ikka benayyhu zar sheachal teruma — leabbaye patur, ulerava chayyayv.

Uleabbaye patur?! vehaamar rav chisda: mode rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana begonev chelbo shel chavero vaachalo, shehu chayyayv — shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem shebba lide issur chelev. alma demeiddana deagbeheh kanyeh, mitchayyev benafsho la hava ad deachel leh. hacha name, beiddana deagbeheh — kanyeh, mitchayyev benafsho la have ad deachel leh! hacha bemay askinan — kegon shettachav lo chavero letoch piv.

Sof sof kevan delaaseh kanyeh, mitchayyev benafsho la have ad devala! kegon shettachav lo letoch bet habbelia. hechi dame? i dematze leahdora — nehdar. i la matze leahdora — ammay chayyayv? la tzericha, dematze leahdora al yede haddechak.
Rav pappa amar: kegon shettachav lo chavero mashkin shel teruma letoch piv. rav ashe amar: bezar sheachal teruma mishshello,

a: Vekara shirain shel chavero.

Gufa, amar rav chisda: mode rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana begonev chelbo shel chavero vaachalo shehu chayyayv, shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide issur chelev. lema peliga derabbi avin. deamar rabbi avin: hazzorek chetz mittechillat arba lesof arba, vekara shirain bahalichato — patur. sheakira tzorech hannacha hi. hacha name: hagebaha tzorech achila hi!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, i efshar lehannacha belo akira. hacha, efshar laachila belo hagebaha, dei bae, gachen veachel. i name: hatam i bae leahdora — la matze mahdar la. hacha — matze mahdar la.

May ikka ben hay lishshana lehay lishshana? ikka benayyhu hammaavir sakkin birshut harabbim vekara shirain bahalichato. lehach lishshana deamrat i efshar lehannacha belo akira — hacha name i efshar lehannacha belo akira. lehach lishshana deamrat la matze mahdar la — hacha matze mahdar la.

Gufa, amar rabbi avin: hazzorek chetz mittechillat arba lesof arba vekara shirain bahalichato — patur, sheakira tzorech hannacha hi. metiv rav bivi bar abbaye: haggonev kis beshabbat — chayyayv, shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide issur sekila. haya megarer veyotze, megarer veyotze — patur, shehare issur shabbat ugeneva bain keechad.
Veammay? hacha name, lema: hagebaha tzorech hotzaa hi! hacha bemay askinan — kegon shehigbiho al menat lehatzenio, venimlach alav vehotzio.

Vechi hay gavvna mi chayyayv? vehaamar rav simon amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: hamefanne chafatzim mizzavit lezavit, venimlach alehem vehotzian — patur, shello hayta akira mishshaa rishona lechach!
La tema al menat lehatzenio, ella ema al menat lehotzio, hacha bemay askinan — kesheamad.
Amad lemay? i lechattef — orcheh hu! ella beomed lafush. aval lechattef may?
b: Patur. addetane: haya megarer veyotze megarer veyotze patur, niflog venitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — beomed lafush, aval lechattef — patur.
Ella: ha manni — ben azzay hi, deamar: mehallech keomed dame. aval zorek may — patur? niflog [venitne] bedida: bamme devarim amurim — bimhallech, aval zorek — patur!
Megarer veyotze itztericha leh, salka datach amena en derech hotzaa bechach. ka mashma lan.
Uvemay? i beravreve — orcheh hu. i bezutere — lav orcheh hu. ella bemitze.

Udeappekeh lehecha? i deappekeh lirshut harabbim — issur shabbat ikka, issur geneva lekka. i deappekeh lirshut hayyachid — issur geneva ikka, issur shabbat — lekka! la tzericha, deappekeh letzidde reshut harabbim.

Ucheman? i kerabbi eliezer deamar tzidde reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim damu — issur shabbat ikka, issur geneva lekka! i kerabbanan deamri tzidde reshut harabbim lav kirshut harabbim damu — issur geneva ikka, issur shabbat lekka!

Leolam kerabbi eliezer, vechi amar rabbi eliezer tzidde reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim damu — hane mille leinyan chiyyuva deshabbat, dezimnin dedachaki rabbim veayyli lehatam. aval leinyan mikne — kane. may tama — deha la shechichi rabbim.
Rav ashe amar: kegon shetztzeraf yado lematta mishshelosha vekibbelo. kidrava. deamar rava: yado shel adam chashuva lo kearbaa al arbaa. rav acha matni hachi.

Ravina matne: leolam deappekeh lirshut harabbim, uvirshut harabbim name kana, vetarvayyhu bediyyuka deha matnitin kamippalgi. ditnan: haya moshcho veyotze umet birshut bealim — patur. higbiho o shehotzio mershut bealim umet — chayyayv.

Ravina dayek meresha, rav acha dayek missefa. ravina dayek meresha: haya moshcho veyotze umet birshut bealim — patur. tama demet birshut bealim, ha hotzio mershut bealim vamet — chayyayv. rav acha dayek missefa: higbiho o shehotzio. hotzaa dumeya dehagbaha: ma hagebaha — deate lirshuteh, af hotzaa name — deate lirshuteh.
Lerav acha kashya resha, leravina kashya sefa! resha lerav acha la kashya: kamma dela ate lirshuteh, reshut bealim karena beh. sefa leravina la kashya: hotzaa dumeya dehagbaha la amrinan.
Habba al achoto veal achot aviv kulei. ureminhu, ellu hen hallokin: habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal hannidda.

a: Vekayyma lan deeno loke umeshallem. amar ulla, la kashya: kan baachoto naara, kan baachoto bogeret.
Achoto bogeret name, ha ikka boshet ufegam! beshota. veha ikka tzaara! bimfutta.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema achoto naara, bitoma umefutta.

Alma kasavar ulla: kol hecha deikka mamon umalkot — mamona meshallem, milka la lake. mena leh leulla ha? gamar mechovel bachavero: ma chovel bachavero deikka mamon umalkot — mamona meshallem, milka la lake; af kol hecha deikka mamon umalkot — mamona meshallem, milka la lake.
Ma lechovel bachavero — shekken chayyayv bachamishsha devarim. vei mamona lekulla — shekken huttar mikkelalo bevet din.
Ella gamar meedim zommin: ma edim zommin deikka mamon umalkot — mamona meshallem, milka la lake; af kol hecha deikka mamon umalkot — mamona meshallem, milka la lake.
Ma leedim zommin — shekken enan tzerichim hateraa. vei mamona lekulla hu — shekken lo asu maase!

Ella gamar mittarvayyhu: ma hatztzad hashshave shebbahen, deikka mamon umalkot — mamona meshallem, milka la lake; af kol hecha deikka mamon umalkot — mamona meshallem, milka la lake. ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen — shekken yesh bahen tzad chamur, vei mamona lekulla hu — shekken yesh bahen tzad hakkal.
b: Ella ulla "tachat" "tachat" gamar. ketiv hacha: "tachat asher innah", uchetiv hatam: "ayin tachat ayin". ma hatam — mamona meshallem, milka la lake; af kol hecha deikka mamona umalkot — mamona meshallem, milka la lake.
Rabbi yochanan amar, afillu tema achoto naara: kan shehitru bo, kan shello hitru bo.

Alma kasavar rabbi yochanan: kol hecha deikka mamon umalkot veatro beh — milka lake, mamona la meshallem. mena leh lerabbi yochanan ha? amar kera: "kede rishato", mishshum risha achat atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum shete rishayot. usemich leh "arbaim yakkennu".

Vahare chovel bachavero, deikka mamon umalkot — mamona meshallem, milka la lake! vechi tema: hane mille hecha dela atro beh, aval atro beh — milka lake, mamona la meshallem, vehaamar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: hikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta — loke. hechi dame? i dela atro beh, ammay loke? ella peshita deatro beh, vetama — delet be shave peruta, ha it be shave peruta — mamona meshallem, milka la lake!

Kidamar rabbi ila: beferush ribbeta tora edim zommin letashlumin, hacha name: beferush ribbeta tora chovel bachavero letashlumin. vehecha ittemar derabbi ila — aha: meidin anu et ish peloni shechayyayv lachavero matayim zuz, venimtzeu zommin — lokin umeshallemin, shello hashshem hammevian lide makkot mevian lide tashlumin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol hameshallem eno loke.

Venema: kol halloke eno meshallem! amar rabbi ila: beferush ribbeta tora edim zommin letashlumin. hechan ribbeta tora? mikkede ketiv: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv", "yad beyad" lema li? davar hannittan miyyad leyad, umay nihu — mamon.
Chovel bachavero name, mikkede ketiv: "kaasher asa ken yease lo", "ken yinnaten bo", lema li? davar sheyyesh bo netina, umay nihu — mamon.
Verabbi yochanan: may tama la amar keulla? im ken, bittalta "ervat achotcha... lo tegalle".

a: Chovel bachavero name, im ken bittalta "lo yosif pen yosif"! edim zommin name, im ken bittalta "vehaya im bin hakkot harasha"! ella: edim zommin, efshar lekayyoma beven gerusha uven chalutza. chovel bachavero name, ikka lekayyoma kegon shehikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta.

Achoto name, ikka lekayyoma baachoto bogeret! amar lach rabbi yochanan: hay "tachat asher innah" mibbee leh lechidabbaye. deamar abbaye, amar kera: "tachat asher innah". hay "tachat asher innah", mikkelal deikka boshet ufegam.
Veulla? nafka leh midderava. deamar rava, amar kera: "venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef", hanaat shechiva chamishshim, mikkelal deikka boshet ufegam.

Rabbi eliezer omer: edim zommin mamona meshallemi umilka la lake, mishshum delav bene hateraa ninhu. amar rava: tidda. naytre behu emat? naytre behu meikkara — amri: ishtelin. naytre behu bishat maase — parshi vela mashadi. naytre behu levassof — may dahava hava.
Matkef la abbaye: venaytre behu betoch kede dibbur? matkef la rav acha bereh derav ika: venaytre behu meikkara unerammez behu rammoze?

Hadar amar abbaye: lav milleta hi daamari. i salka datach edim zommin tzerichin hateraa, ki la matrinan behu la katlinan lehu. mi ikka midde deinhu bau katli bela hateraa, veinhu bau hateraa? ha baenan "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv", velekka.

Matkef la rav samma bereh derav yirmeya: ella meatta, ben gerusha uven chalutza, dela mikkaasher zamam" ka mitrabbe — live hateraa! amar kera: "mishpat echad yihye lachem", mishpat hashshave lechullechem.

Rav shisha bereh derav idi amar: chovel bachavero name, mamona meshallem umilka la lake, mehacha: "vechi yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha hara veyatzu yeladeha". veamar rabbi elazar: bematztzut shebbemita hakkatuv medabber, dichtiv: "veim ason yihye venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh".
Hechi dame? i dela atro beh — ammay mikketil? ella peshita deatro beh, umutere ledavar chamur, have mutere ledavar hakkal. veamar rachamana "velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh".
Matkef la, rav ashe: mimmay demutere ledavar chamur have mutere ledavar hakkal? dilma la have?! im timtza lomar have, mimmay demita chamura?
b: Dilma malkot chamur? deamar rav: ilmale naggedu lachananya mishael vaazarya — pelachu letzalma! amar leh rav samma bereh derav assi lerav ashe, veamri la rav samma bereh derav ashe lerav ashe: vela shane lach ben hakkaa sheyyesh lah kitzva lehakkaa sheen lah kitzva?
Matkef la rav yaakov minnehar pekod: hanicha lerabbanan deamri nefesh mammash, ella lerabbi deamar mamon, may ikka lememar?

Ella amar rav yaakov minnehar pekod mishshemeh derava, mehacha: "im yakum vehithallech bachutz al mishanto venikka hammakke", vechi taale al datecha shezze mehallech bashshuk, veze neherag? ella melammed shechovshin oto, vei mayet — katlinan leh, vei la mayet — "shivto yitten verappo yerappe".
Hechi dame? i dela atro beh — ammay mikketil! ella peshita deatro beh, umutere ledavar chamur, mutere ledavar hakkal, veamar rachamana "shivto yitten verappo yerappe".

Matkef la rav ashe: mimmay demutere ledavar chamur have mutere ledavar hakkal? dilma la have! veim timtza lomar have, mimmay demita chamura? dilma malkot chamur? deamar rav: ilmale naggedu lachananya mishael vaazarya, pelachu letzalma!
Amar leh rav samma bereh derav assi lerav ashe, veamri la rav samma bereh derav ashe lerav ashe: vela shane lach ben hakkaa sheyyesh lah kitzva lehakkaa sheen lah kitzva?
Matkef la rav mari: mimmay divmezid, "venikka" — mikketala? dilma beshogeg, "venikka" — miggalut? kashya.
Resh lakish amar: ha manni — rabbi meir hi, deamar: loke umeshallem. i rabbi meir — afillu bitto name!

Vechi tema: rabbi meir, loke umeshallem — it leh, met umeshallem — let leh, vela? vehatanya: ganav vetavach beshabbat, ganav vetavach laavoda zara, ganav shor hanniskal utevacho — meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim potrin!

Ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la: amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, rabbi avin verabbi ila vechol chavurata mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amri: betoveach al yede acher.
Vechi ze chote veze mitchayyev? amar rava, amar rachamana: "utevacho o mecharo", ma mechira al yede acher, af tevicha al yede acher.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "o" — lerabbot et hashshaliach. deve chizkiyya tana: "tachat" — lerabbot et hashshaliach.
Matkef la mar zutera: mi ikka midde deillu avad ihu la michayyayv, veaved sheliach umichayyayv? ihu, lav mishshum dela michayyayv, ella mishshum dekam leh bidrabba minneh.
I betoveach al yede acher, may tamayyhu derabbanan defatri? man chachamim —

a: Rabbi shimon hi, deamar: shechita sheenah reuya — lo shemah shechita. hatinach avoda zara veshor hanniskal, ella shechitat shabbat — shechita reuya hi! ditnan: hashshochet beshabbat uveyom hakkippurim, af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho — shechitato keshera!

Savar la kerabbi yochanan hassandelar. detanya: hamevashshel beshabbat, beshogeg — yochal, bemezid — lo yochal, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshogeg — yochal lemotzae shabbat, bemezid — lo yochal olamit. rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer: beshogeg — yeachel lemotzae shabbat laacherim velo lo, bemezid — lo yeachel olamit, lo lo velo laacherim.

May tama derabbi yochanan hassandelar? kiddaresh rabbi chiyyay appitcha deve nesia: "ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi lachem", ma kodesh asur baachila — af maase shabbat asurin baachila. i: ma kodesh asur bahanaa — af maase shabbat asur bahanaa! talmud lomar: "lachem" — shellachem yehe.
Yachol afillu beshogeg? talmud lomar: "mechalleleha mot yumat", bemezid amarti lecha, velo beshogeg.

Peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: maase shabbat deorayyta, vechad amar: derabbanan. man deamar deorayyta — kedaamaran, man deamar derabbanan — amar kera: "kodesh hi", hi kodesh, veen maaseha kodesh.
Uleman deamar derabbanan, may tamayyhu derabbanan defatri? ki ka patri rabbanan ashsheara.
Toveach laavoda zara, kevan dishchat beh pureta — ittesar leh, iddach ki ka tavach, lav demareh ka tavach! amar rava: beomer bigmar zevicha hu ovdah.
Shor hanniskal, lav dideh hu dekatavach! amar rabba: hacha bemay askinan — kegon shemmesaro leshomer, vehizzik bevet shomer, venigmar dino bevet shomer, ugenavo gannav mibbet shomer.

Verabbi meir, savar la kerabbi yaakov, vesavar la kerabbi shimon. savar la kerabbi yaakov deamar: af mishshennigmar dino hechziro shomer livalav — muchezar. vesavar la kerabbi shimon deamar: davar haggorem lemamon — kemamon dame.
Rabba amar: leolam betoveach al yede atzmo,
b: Verabbi meir, loke umeshallem it leh, met umeshallem let leh. veshane hane, dechiddush hu shechiddesha tora biknas, af al gav demikketil — meshallem. veazda rabba letameh, deamar rabba: haya gedi ganuv lo, utevacho beshabbat — chayyayv, shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide issur shabbat. ganav vetavach beshabbat — patur, sheim en geneva, en tevicha veen mechira.

Veamar rabba: haya gedi ganuv lo utevacho bammachteret — chayyayv, shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide issur machteret. ganav vetavach bammachteret — patur, sheim en geneva, en tevicha veen mechira.

Utzericha. dei ashmeinan shabbat — mishshum deissurah issur olam. aval machteret, deissur shaa hu — ema la. vei ashmeinan machteret — mishshum demachtarto zo hi hateraato. aval shabbat, devaaya hateraa — ema la, tzericha.

Amar rav pappa: hayta para genuva lo, utevachah beshabbat — chayyayv, shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide issur shabbat. hayta para sheula lo, utevachah beshabbat — patur. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: rav pappa, para ata leashmoinan?!

Amar leh: rav pappa, sheula ata leashmoinan. salka datach amena, hoil veamar rav pappa: mishsheat meshicha hu deitchayyayv leh bimzonoteha, hacha name: mishsheat sheela itchayyayv beuneseha. ka mashma lan.

Amar rava: hinniach lahen avihen para sheula — mishtammeshin bah kol yeme sheelatah, meta — en chayyayvin beonsah. kisvurin shel avihem hi utevachuha vaachaluha — meshallemin deme vasar bezol. hinniach lahen avihen achrayut nechasim — chayyayvin leshallem.
Ikka dematne la aresha, veikka dematne la assefa. man dematne la aresha, kol shekken assefa — ufeliga derav pappa. uman dematne la assefa, aval aresha la — vehayeynu derav pappa.
Bishlama rabbi yochanan la amar keresh lakish, deka mokem lah kerabbanan. ella resh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan? amar lach: kevan deillu atro beh — patur, ki la atro beh — name patur.

Veazdu letamayyhu. dechi ata rav dimi, amar: chayyayve mitot shoggin, vechayyayve malkiyyot shoggin vedavar acher — rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, veresh lakish amar: patur. rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv — deha la atro beh. resh lakish amar patur — kevan deillu atro beh — patur, ki la atro beh — name patur.
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: "velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh",

a: May lav, ason mammash! la, din ason. ikka deamri, etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: "velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh", may lav, din ason? lo, ason mammash.
Amar rava: umi ikka leman deamar chayyayve mitot shoggin chayyayvim? veha tana deve chizkiyya: "makke adam" umakke vehema" —

Ma makke vehema lo chillakta bo ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben mitkavven lesheen mitkavven, ben derech yerida lederech aliyyay lefotro mamon, ella lechayyeyvo mamon — af makke adam lo tachlok bo ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben mitkavven lesheen mitkavven, ben derech yerida lederech aliyyay — lechayyeyvo mamon, ella lefotro mamon.

Ella, ki ata ravin amar: chayyayve mitot shoggin — kulle alma la peligi difturin. ki peligi, bechayyayve malkot shoggin vedavar acher. rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv: chayyayve mitot ittakkush, chayyayve malkiyyot la ittakkush. resh lakish amar patur: beferush ribbeta tora chayyayve malkiyyot kechayyayve mitot.

Hechan ribbeta tora? amar abbaye: atya "rasha" "rasha". rava amar atya "makke" "makke". amar leh rav pappa lerava: he "makke"? ilema "umakke vehema yeshallemenna umakke adam yumat" — hay biktala ketiv! ella hay "makke": "makke nefesh behema yeshallemenna nefesh tachat nafesh", usemich leh: "veish ki yitten mum baamito [kaasher asa ken yease lo]".

Vehay lav "makke" hi! anan hakkaa hakkaa kaamrinan. veha ki ketiv — bechovel bachavero hu dichtiv, vechovel bachavero bar tashlumin hu! im eno inyan lehakkaa sheyyesh bah shave peruta — tenehu inyan lehakkaa sheen bah shave peruta.
b: Sof sof lav bar tashlumin hu? la tzericha, devahade demachyeh, kera shirain dileh.
Amar leh rav chiyyay lerava: uletanna deve chizkiyya deamar "makke adam" umakke vehema", mimmay divchol ketiv velekka leippeloge, dilma beshabbat ketiv devivhema gufa ikka leippeloge!

La salka datach, dichtiv: "umakke vehema yeshallemenna umakke adam yumat". hechi dame? i dela atro beh, makke adam ammay yumat? ella peshita deatro beh. vei beshabbat, makke behema yeshallemenna?! ella lav bechol.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lerabba deamar chiddush hu shechiddesha tora biknas, veaf al gav demikketil, meshallem, matnitin keman mokem la? i kerabbi meir, kashya bitto! i kerabbi nechuneya ben hakkana, kashya achoto! i kerabbi yitzchak, kashya mamzeret!
Hanicha i savar la kerabbi yochanan — hu name metaretz la kerabbi yochanan. ella i savar keresh lakish, hechi metaretz la? al korchach kerabbi yochanan sevira leh.
Amar leh rav matna leabbaye, leresh lakish deamar: beferush ribbeta tora chayyayve malkiyyot kechayyayve mitot, man tanna diflig aleh derabbi nechuneya ben hakkana? i rabbi meir, i rabbi yitzchak.

Tanu rabbanan: arayot usheniyyot laarayot — en lahen lo kenas velo pittuy. hamemaenet — en lah lo kenas velo pittuy. ayylonit — en lah lo kenas velo pittuy, vehayyotzet mishshum shem ra — en lah lo kenas velo pittuy.
May "arayot" umay "sheniyyot laarayot"? ilema "arayot" —

a: Arayot mammash, "sheniyyot" — middivre sofrim, kevan demiddeorayyta chazya leh, ammay en lahen kenas? ella: "arayot" — chayyayve mitot bet din, "sheniyyot" — chayyayve charetot. aval chayyayve lavin yesh lahen kenas, umanni shimon hattimni hi.
Ikka deamri "arayot" — chayyayve mitot bet din vechayyayve charetot, "sheniyyot" — chayyayve lavin. manni — rabbi shimon ben menasya hi.

Hamemaenet en lah lo kenas velo pittuy. ha ketanna bealma — it la. manni — rabbanan hi deamri: ketanna yesh lah kenas, ema sefa: ayylonit en lah lo kenas velo pittuy. atan lerabbi meir, deamar: ketanna en lah kenas, veha mikkatnutah yatzta leveger. resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir!

Vechi tema: kulla rabbi meir hi, uvimmaenet savar la kerabbi yehuda. umi savar la? vehatanya: ad matay habbat memaenet — ad shettavi shete searot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyirbe shachor al hallavan.

Ella: rabbi yehuda hi, uviktanna savar la kerabbi meir. umi savar la? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir. veim ita, "zo divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda" mibbee leh! hay tanna savar la kerabbi meir bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Rafram amar: may "memaenet" — haruya lemaen. velitne ketanna! kashya.

Ayylonit en lah lo kenas velo pittuy. ureminhi: hachereshet vehashshota vehaayylonit — yesh lahen kenas, veyesh lahen taanat betulim. veha, may rumeya? ha rabbi meir, ha rabbanan! udekaare la, may kaare la!

Mishshum deit leh lemirme achariti illaveh: hachereshet vehashshota vehabbogeret vmukkat etz — en lahen taanat betulim. hassoma veayylonit — yesh lahen taanat betulim. somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: soma en lah taanat betulim.

Amar rav sheshet, la kashya: ha rabban gamliel, veha rabbi yehoshua. emar deshamat leh lerabban gamliel hecha deka taana ihi, hecha dela ka taana ihi, mi shamat leh? in, kevan deamar rabban gamliel mehemna, kegon zo "petach picha leillem" hu.
Vehabbogeret en lah taanat betulim. vehaamar rav: bogeret, notnin lah layla harishon!
b: I deka taen taanat damim — hachi name. hacha bemay askinan — dekataen taanat petach patuach.

Somchos omer mishshum rabbi meir: soma en lah taanat betulim. may tama desomchos? amar rabbi zera: mippene shennechbetet al gabbe karka. kullehu name chabbote michabbeti? kullehu, root umarot leimman. zo, enah roa veenah mara leimmah.

Vehayyotzet mishshum shem ra en lah lo kenas velo pittuy. hayyotzet mishshum shem ra — bat sekila hi! amar rav sheshet: hachi kaamar: mi sheyyatza aleha shem ra beyaldutah — en lah lo kenas velo pittuy.

Amar rav pappa, shema minna: hay shetara ria la magbenan beh. hechi dame? illema dinfak kala aleh dishtara (d)zayyfa hu, dichvota hacha, dinfak ala kala dezannay, veha amar rava: yatza lah shem mezanna bair — en choshshin lah.

Ella daato be tere veamri: ledidhu tevatanhi beissura. dichvota hacha: daato be tere veamri: ledidhu amar lehu: "zayyifu li". bishlama hatam — shechichi perutzin. ella hacha, im hu huchezak, kol yisrael mi huchezku? hacha name: kevan deka mehaddar azziyyufa, emar, zayyofe zayyef uchetav.

Mishna veellu sheen lahen kenas: habba al haggiyyoret veal hashshevuya veal hashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeyru veshennishtachreru, yeterot al benot shalosh shanim veyom echad. rabbi yehuda omer: shevuya shennifdet — hare hi bikdushshatah, af al pi sheggedola.

Habba al bitto, al bat bitto, al bat beno, al bat ishto, al bat benah, al bat bittah — en lahen kenas, mippene shemmitchayyev benafsho, shemmitatan bide bet din. vechol hammitchayyev benafsho en meshallem mamon, shenneemar: "veim lo yihye ason anosh yeanesh".

Gemara amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yehuda verabbi dosa amru davar echad. rabbi yehuda — ha daamaran. rabbi dosa, detanya: shevuya — ochelet bitruma, divre rabbi dosa. amar rabbi dosa: vechi ma asa lah arvi hallaz? vechi mippene shemmiech lah ben daddeha, pesalah min hakkehunna?

Amar rabba: dilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hacha, ella shello yehe chote niskar? aval hatam — kerabbanan sevira leh. i name: ad kan la kaamar rabbi dosa hatam, ella bitruma derabbanan. aval kenas deorayyta — kerabbanan sevira leh.

Amar leh abbaye: vetameh derabbi yehuda hacha, shello yehe chote niskar hu? veha tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: shevuya shennishbet — hare hi bikdushshatah, afillu bat eser shanim — ketubbatah matayim. vehatam may "shello yehe chote niskar" ikka? hatam name, dilma mimmani vela nasvi la.

Vesavar rabbi yehuda bikdusheta kayyma? vehatanya: happode et hashshevuya — yissaenna. meid bah — lo yissaenna. rabbi yehuda omer: ben kach uven kach lo yissaenna! ha gufa kashya, amrat: happode et hashshevuya — yissaenna, vahadar tena: meid bah — lo yissaenna. mishshum demeid bah lo yissaenna?!
Ha la kashya, hachi kaamar: happode et hashshevuya umeid bah — yissaenna, meid bah kedi — lo yissaenna.

Mikkol makom kashya lerabbi yehuda! amar rav pappa, ema: rabbi yehuda omer: ben kach uven kach yissaenna. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua omer: leolam kidkatane, rabbi yehuda ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi — ben kach uven kach yissaenna, ella ledidchu — ben kach uven kach lo yissaenna mibbee leh!
Verabbanan: happode et hashshevuya umeid bah yissaenna — la shade inish zuze bichdi. meid bah kedi lo yissaenna — shemma enav natan bah.
Rame leh rav pappa bar shemuel lerav yosef:

a: Vesavar rabbi yehuda bikdusheta kayyma? vehatanya: haggiyyoret shennitgayyeyra veraata dam, rabbi yehuda omer: dayyah sheatah. rabbi yose omer: hare hi kechol hannashim, umetammea meet leet, umippekida lifkida.
Utzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose mattir leares velinnase miyyad. amar leh: giyyoret ashshevuyah ka ramet? giyyoret la menattera nafsha, shevuya menattera nafsha.

Uremi shevuya ashshevuyah, detanya: haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeyru veshennishtachreru yeterot al benot shalosh shanim veyom echad — tzerichot lehametin shelosha chodashim, divre rabbi yehuda, rabbi yose mattir leares velinnase miyyad. ishtik.

Amar leh: midde shemia lach beha? amar leh: hachi amar rav sheshet, sherauha shennivala. i hachi may tama derabbi yose? amar rabba, kasavar rabbi yose: ishsha mezanna meshammeshet bemoch, shello titabber.
Bishlama giyyoret, kevan dedata leiggayyore menattera nafsha. shevuya name, dela yada hecha mamtu lah. shifcha name, deshama mippi mara. ella yotza beshen vaayin, may ikka lememar?

Vechi tema kol mimmela la amar rabbi yose, hare anusa umefutta, demimmela, vetanya: anusa umefutta tzerichot lehametin shelosha chodashim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose mattir leares velinnase miyyad!
Ella amar rabba: kasavar rabbi yose: ishsha mezanna mithappechet kede shello titabber. veiddach? chayyshinan shemma lo nehefcha yafe yafe.
Shenneemar velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh vechulei. veha mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "kede rishato", mishshum risha achat atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum shete rishayot!
Chada bemita umamon, vachada bemalkot umamon. utzericha: dei ashmeinan mita umamon, mishshum deikka ibbud neshama, aval malkot umamon, delekka ibbud neshama, ema la.
Vei ashmeinan malkot umamon, mishshum dela chamir issureh. aval mita umamon, dachamir issureh, ema la. tzericha.
Ulerabbi meir deamar loke umeshallem, tarte lema li? chada bemita umamon,
b: Vachada bemita umalkot. utzericha, dei ashmeinan mita umamon, mishshum dachada begufeh vachada bemamoneh la avdinan. aval bemita umalkot, deidde veidde begufeh, ema mita arichta hi, venabed beh.
Vei ashmeinan mita umalkot, detarte begufeh la avdinan. aval mita umamon, dachada begufeh vachada bemamoneh, ema naaved beh. tzericha.

"Velo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach" lema li? deamar rachamana: la tishkol mamona minneh vetiftereh mikketala. "lo tikchu chofer lanus el ir miklato" lema li? deamar rachamana: la tishkol mamona minneh vetiftereh min galut.

Utere kerae lema li! chad beshogeg vechad bemezid. utzerichi, dei ashmeinan mezid, mishshum dachamir issureh. aval shogeg, dela chamir issureh — ema la. vei ashmeinan shogeg, mishshum delekka ibbud neshama. aval mezid, deikka ibbud neshama — ema la. tzericha.
"Velaaretz lo yechuppar laddam asher shuppach bah ki im bedam shofcho" lema li?
Mibbee leh lechidtanya: minnayin sheim nitarfa agala veachar kach nimtza hahoreg, minnayin sheen potrin oto — shenneemar: "velaaretz lo yechuppar laddam asher shuppach bah vegomer".

"Veatta tevaer haddam hannaki mikkirbecha" lema li? mibbee leh, lechidtanya: minnayin lemumatim besayif shehu min hatztzavvar — talmud lomar: "veatta tevaer haddam hannaki mikkirbecha" — hukeshu kol shofche damim leegla arufa, ma lehallan min hatztzavvar — af shofche damim min hatztzavvar.
I ma lehallan bekofitz umimmul oref, af kan bekofitz umimmul oref? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu, amar kera: "veahavta lereacha kamocha", beror lo mita yafa.
"Kol cherem asher yochoram min haadam lo yippade" lema li? mibbee leh lechidtanya: minnayin layyotze lehareg, veamar echad "erko alay", minnayin shello amar kelum —
Shenneemar: "kol cherem asher yochoram min haadam lo yippade". yachol af kodem shennigmar dino ken? talmud lomar: "min haadam" — velo kol haadam.
Ulerabbi chananya ben akavya, deamar: neerach — mippene sheddamav ketzuvin, hay "kol cherem" may aved leh?

Mibbee leh lechidtanya: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: lefi shemmatzinu lemumatim bide shamayim shennotnin mamon umitkapper lahen, shenneemar: "im kofer yushat alav". yachol af bide adam ken? talmud lomar: "cherem min haadam lo yippade".
Veen li ella mitot chamurot shello nittena shiggatan lechappara, mitot kallot shennittena shiggatan lechappara, minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol cherem".
Vela mimmela millo tikchu kofer" shamat minna — la tishkol mamona minneh vetiftereh? "kol cherem" lema li? amar rame bar chama: itzterich, salka datach amena:

a: Hane mille, hecha daharago derech aliyyay, shello nittena shiggato lechappara. aval harago derech yerida, denittena shiggato lechappara, ema: nishkol mamona minneh veniftereh, ka mashma lan.
Amar leh rava: ha middetanna deve chizkiyya nafka. detana deve chizkiyya: "makke adam" umakke vehema".

Ma makke vehema lo chillakta bo ben shogeg lemezid, ben mitkavven lesheen mitkavven, ben derech yerida lederech aliyyay — lefotro mamon ella lechayyeyvo mamon. af makke adam lo tachlok bo ben shogeg lemezid, ben mitkavven lesheen mitkavven, ben derech yerida lederech aliyya — lechayyeyvo mamon ella lefotro mamon.

Ella amar rame bar chama, itzterich: salka datach amena, hane mille hecha desimme et eno vaharago bah. aval hecha desimme et eno vaharago bedavar acher, ema nishkol mamona minneh. amar leh rava: ha name meiddach tanna deve chizkiyya nafka. detana deve chizkiyya: "ayin tachat ayin", velo ayin venefesh tachat ayin.

Ella amar rav ashe: itzterich. salka datach amena hoil vechiddush hu shechiddesha tora biknas, af al gav demikketil meshallem, ka mashma lan. ulerabba deamar chiddush hu shechiddesha tora biknas, af al gav demikketil meshallem, hay "kol cherem" may aved leh? savar la ketanna kamma derabbi chananya ben akavya.
Mishna naara shennitarsa venitgarsha — rabbi yose haggelili omer: en lah kenas. rabbi akiva omer: yesh lah kenas, ukenasah leatzmah.
Gemara may tama derabbi yose haggelili — amar kera: "asher lo orasa", ha orasa — en lah kenas. verabbi akiva? "asher lo orasa" — leaviha, ha orsa — leatzmah.
Ella meatta, "naara" velo bogeret, hachi name dilatzmah? "betula" velo beula, hachi name dilatzmah? ella ligmare, hacha name ligmare!

Amar lach rabbi akiva: hay "la orasa" mibbee leh lechidtanya: "asher lo orasa" — perat lenaara shennitarsa venitgarsha, sheen lah kenas, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: yesh lah kenas, ukenasah leaviha. vehaddin noten: hoil veaviha zakkay bechesef kiddusheha, veaviha zakkay bechesef kenasah. ma kesef kiddusheha, af al pi shennitarsa venitgarsha — leaviha, af kesef kenasah, af al pi shennitarsa venitgarsha — leaviha.

Im ken, ma talmud lomar: "asher lo orasa" — mufene, lehakkish lo veladun hemennu gezera shava: neemar kan "asher lo orasa", veneemar lehallan "asher lo orasa". ma kan chamishshim — af lehallan chamishshim, uma lehallan shekalim — af kan shekalim.
Verabbi akiva, may chazet daasher lo orasa" ligzera shava, uvetula" lemaote beula?
b: Ema: "betula" — ligzera shava, vaasher lo orasa" — perat lenaara shennitarsa venitgarsha!

Mistabbera "asher lo orasa" ligzera shava, shehare ani kore bah "naara betula". adderabba: "betula" ligzera shava, shehare ani kore bah "asher lo orasa"! mistabbera: ha ishtanni gufa, veha la ishtanni gufa.
Verabbi yose haggelili hay sevara mena leh? nafka leh middetanya: "kesef yishkol kemohar habbetulot", sheyyehe ze kemohar habbetulot, umohar habbetulot kaze.
Kashya derabbi akiva adderabbi akiva. tere tannae veallibba derabbi akiva.
Bishlama rabbi akiva dematnitin, la atya gezera shava umappeka leh likra mippeshateh ligmare. ella lerabbi akiva devarayyta, atya gezera shava umappeka mippeshateh ligmare.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: keri beh "asher lo arusa". arusa bat sekila hi! salka datach amena: hoil vechiddush hu shechiddesha tora biknas, af al gav demikketil — meshallem.
Ulerabba deamar chiddush hu shechiddesha tora biknas, af al gav demikketil meshallem, may ikka lememar? savar la kerabbi akiva dematnitin.

Tanu rabbanan: kenasah lemi, leaviha. veyesh omrim: leatzmah. leatzmah ammay! amar rav chisda: hacha benaara shennitarsa venitgarsha askinan, vekamippalgi biflugeta derabbi akiva dematnitin verabbi akiva devarayyta.
Amar abbaye: ba aleha umeta — patur, shenneemar: "venatan laavi hannaara" — velo laavi meta. milleta difshita leh leabbaye, mibbaya leh lerava.
Devae rava: yesh beger bakkever, o en beger bakkever? yesh beger bakkever — vedivnah have, o dilma: en beger bakkever, udeaviha have.

a: Umi miabbera? vehatane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman: shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch, ellu hen: ketanna, umeubberet, umenika. ketanna — shemma titabber vetamut, meubberet — shemma taase ubbarah sandal, menika — shemma tigmol et benah.

Veezohi ketanna — mibbat achat esre shana veyom echad ad shetem esre shana veyom echad. pachot mikken veyater al ken meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: achat zo veachat zo meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet, umin hashshamayim yerachemu, mishshum shenneemar: "shomer petaim Adonai"!

Vechi tema deiabbara keshehi naara, veolida keshehi naara. uveshitta yarche mi ka yalda? vehaamar shemuel: en ben naarut levagrut ella shishsha chodashim. vechi tema: betzir hu delekka, ha tefe — ikka, ha "ella" kaamar!
Ella, hachi kamibbaya leh: yesh beger bakkever ufaka av, o dilma: en beger bakkever, vela paka av? mar bar rav ashe bae la hachi: mita osa bagrut, o en osa bagrut? teku.

Bea minneh rava meabbaye: ba aleha venitarsa, mahu? amar leh, mi ketiv: "venatan laavi hannaara asher lo arusa"? uletamaych, ha detanya: ba aleha venisset, leatzmah: mi ketiv "venatan laavi hannaara asher lo nesua"?

Hachi hasheta?! hatam, hoil uvagrut motzia mershut av, venissuin motziin mershut av, ma bagrut ba aleha uvagra — leatzmah, af nissuin ba aleha venisset — leatzmah. ella erusin, mi ka mappeki mershuta deav ligmare? ha tenan: naara hameorasa aviha uvalah mefirin lah nedareha.

Mishna hamefatte noten shelosha devarim, vehaones arbaa. hamefatte noten boshet ufegam ukenas, mosif alav ones shennoten et hatztzaar. ma ben ones limfatte: haones noten et hatztzaar, vehamefatte eno noten et hatztzaar. haones noten miyyad, vehamefatte lichsheyyotzi. haones shote baatzitzo, vehamefatte, im ratza lehotzi — motzi.

Ketzad shote baatzitzo: afillu hi chiggeret, afillu hi soma, vaafillu hi mukkat shechin. nimtza bah devar erva, o sheenah reuya lavo beyisrael — eno rashshay lekayyeymah, shenneemar: "velo tihye leishsha", ishsha haruya lo.

Gemara tzaar demay? amar avu dishmuel: tzaar shechavatah al gabbe karka. matkef la rabbi zera: ella meatta, chavatah al gabbe shirain, hachi name defatur? vechi tema hachi name — vehatanya, rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: ones eno meshallem et hatztzaar — mippene
b: Shessofah lehitztaer tachat baalah. amru lo: eno dome nivelet beones lenivelet beratzon. ella amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: tzaar shel pissuk haraglayim. vechen hu omer: "vattefasseki et raglayich lechol over".

I hachi, mefutta name! amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: mashal dimfutta lema haddavar dome? leadam sheamar lachavero: kera shirain shelli vehippater. shelli?! daavu ninhu? ella amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: pikkechot shebbahen omrot: mefutta en lah tzaar.

Veha ka chazenan deit la? amar abbaye: amara li em, kemayya chammime al resheh dekarcha. rava amar: amara li bat rav chisda: ki rivda dechusilta. rav pappa amar: amara li bat abba suraa: ki nahama akkusha bechinche.

Haones noten miyyad hamefatte lichsheyyotzi vechulei. lichsheyyotzi?! ishto hi? amar abbaye: ema lichshello yichnos. tanya name hachi: af al pi sheamru hamefatte noten lichshello yichnos, boshet ufegam noten miyyad. veechad haones veechad hamefatte, ben hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev.
Bishlama mefutta — ketiv: "im maen yemaen aviha". en li ella aviha, hi atzmah minnayin — talmud lomar: "yemaen", mikkol makom.
Ella ones? bishlama ihi — ketiv: "velo tihye", middatah. ella aviha menalan?

Amar abbaye: shello yehe chote niskar. rava amar: kal vachomer, uma mefatte shello avar ella al daat aviha bilvad, ben hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev — ones sheavar al daat aviha veal daat atzmah, lo kol shekken?!

Rava la amar keabbayye. kevan deka meshallem kenas, lav chote niskar hu. abbaye la amar kerava: mefatte deihu matze meakkev — aviha name matze meakkev, ones deihu la matze meakkev — aviha name la matze meakkev.

Tanya iddach: af al pi sheamru ones noten miyyad, kesheyyotzi hu en lah alav kelum. kesheyyotzi?! mi matze mappek la?! ema: keshettetze hi, en lah alav kelum. met — yatza kesef kenasah bichtubbatah. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: yesh lah ketubba mane.

Bemay kamippalgi. rabbanan savri: tama may takkinu rabbanan ketubba — kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah, veha la matze mappek la. verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar: ha name metzaar la ad deamra hi "la baena lach".
Ones shote baatzitzo. amar leh rava mipparzikya lerav ashe: mikkede migmar gamri mehadade,

a: Leha milleta name ligmeru mehadade! amar kera: "mahor yimharenna lo leishsha", "lo" — middato.
Ketzad shote baatzitzo kulei. amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea: nete ase venidche lo taase!
Amar li: hecha amrinan nete ase venidche lo taase — kegon mila betzaraat, dela efshar lekayyomeh laase. aval hacha, i amra dela baena, mi iteh laase kelal?
Mishna yetoma shennitarsa venitgarsha, rabbi elazar omer: haones — chayyayv, vehamefatte — patur.

Gemara amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi elazar beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah, deamar: yesh lah kenas ukenasah leatzmah. mimmay — middekatane: yetoma, rabbi elazar omer: haones chayyayv, vehamefatte patur.
Yetoma, peshita? ella ha ka mashma lan denaara shennitarsa venitgarsha, kitoma. ma yetoma — leatzmah, af naara shennitarsa venitgarsha — leatzmah.
Amar rabbi zera amar rabba bar shela amar rav hamenuna sava amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar. kare rav aleh derabbi elazar: "tuveyana dechakkime".

Mishna ezehu boshet? hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. pegam — roin otah keillu hi shifcha nimkeret bashshuk, kamma hayta yafa, vechamma hi yafa. kenas — shave bechol adam, vechol sheyyesh lo kitzva min hattora — shave bechol adam.

Gemara veema: chamishshim selaim amar rachamana, mikkol mille! amar rabbi zera yomru: baal bat melachim chamishshim, baal bat hedyotot chamishshim?! amar leh abbaye: i hachi, gabbe eved name, yomru: eved nokev margaliyyot — sheloshim, eved ose
b: Maase machat — sheloshim?!

Ella amar rabbi zera: illu bau aleha shenayim, echad kedarkah, veechad shello kedarkah, yomru: baal shelema — chamishshim, baal peguma — chamishshim? amar leh abbaye: i hachi, gabbe eved name, yomru: eved bari — sheloshim, eved mukke shechin — sheloshim?!

Ella amar abbaye, amar kera: "tachat asher innah", hane tachat asher innah, mikkelal deikka boshet ufegam. rava amar, amar kera: "venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef". hanaat shechiva chamishshim, mikkelal deikka boshet ufegam.
Veema ledida? amar kera: "binureha bet aviha", kol shevach neureha — leaviha.

Veella ha deamar rav huna amar rav: minnayin shemmaase habbat leaviha, shenneemar: "vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama. ma ama, maase yadeha lerabbah — af bat, maase yadeha leaviha. lema li? tippok leh mibbinureha bet aviha"! ella, hahi bahafarat nedarim hu dichtiv.
Vechi tema nelaf minneh, mamona meissura la yalfinan. vechi tema nelaf mikkenasa, mamona mikkenasa la yalfinan. ella mistabbera deaviha have, dei bae masar la limnuuol umukke shechin.
Pegam, roin otah keillu hi shifcha nimkeret. hechi shayyminan la? amar avu dishmuel: omdin kamma adam rotze litten ben shifcha betula leshifcha beula leshammesho.
May nafka leh minna? ella ben shifcha beula leshifcha sheenah beula, lehassia leavdo. uleavdo may nafka leh minna? beeved sheyyesh lo lerabbo korat ruach hemennu.

Mishna kol makom sheyyesh mecher — en kenas. vechol makom sheyyesh kenas — en mecher. ketanna — yesh lah mecher, veen lah kenas. naara — yesh lah kenas, veen lah mecher. habbogeret — en lah lo mecher velo kenas.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: yesh lah kenas bimkom mecher. detanya: ketanna mibbat yom echad vead shettavi shete searot — yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas. mishshettavi shete searot ad shettivgar — yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher, divre rabbi meir. shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol makom sheyyesh mecher — en kenas, vechol makom sheyyesh kenas — en mecher. vachachamim omrim: ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad vead shettivgar — yesh lah kenas.

Kenas in, mecher la?! ema: af kenas bimkom mecher. amar rav chisda: may tama derabbi meir? amar kera: "velo tihye leishsha" — bimhavva atzmah hakkatuv medabber. verabbanan? amar resh lakish, amar kera: "naara", afillu ketanna bammashma.

Shama rav pappa bereh derav chanan mibbe chelochit, azal amra kammeh derav shimi bar ashe. amar leh: attun, aha matnitu la. anan, aha matnenan lah, amar resh lakish: hammotzi shem ra al hakketanna — patur, shenneemar: "venatnu laavi hannaara", "naara" male dibber hakkatuv.

Matkef la rav adda bar ahava: tama dichtav rachamana "naara", ha lav hachi, hava amena afillu ketanna? veha ketiv: "veim emet haya haddavar hazze lo nimtzeu vetulim lannaara. vehotziu et hannaara el petach bet aviha usekaluha", uketanna lav bat onashin hi! ella: kan naara, ha kol makom shenneemar "naara" — afillu ketanna bammashma.

a: Mishna haomer: "pittiti et bitto shel peloni" — meshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo, veen meshallem kenas. haomer: "ganavti" — meshallem et hakkeren al pi atzmo, veen meshallem tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha. "hemit shori et peloni", o "shoro shel peloni" — hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo. "hemit shori avdo shel peloni" — en meshallem al pi atzmo. ze hakkelal: kol hameshallem yater al ma shehizzik — eno meshallem al pi atzmo.
Gemara velitne "anasti"! la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya "anasti", dela ka pagem la, dimshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo, aval "pittiti", deka pagem la, ema: la meshallem al pi atzmo — ka mashma lan.
Matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: af boshet ufegam eno meshallem al pi atzmo — lo kol hemennu sheyyifgom bitto shel peloni.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: nicha la ledida, may? dilma la nicha leh leaviha. nicha leh leaviha, may? dilma la nicha lehu livne mishpacha. nicha lehu livne mishpacha, may? i efshar delekka chad bimdinat hayyam dela nicha leh.
Haomer ganavti meshallem et hakkeren vechulei. ittemar, palga nizka, rav pappa amar: palga nizka — mamona. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: palga nizka — kenasa.

Rav pappa amar palga nizka mamona, kasavar: setam shevavrim lav bechezkat shimmur kayymi. uvedin hu dimshallem kulleh, verachamana hu dechayes illaveh, deakkatti la iyyaad tora. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar palga nizka kenasa, kasavar: setam shevavrim bechezkat shimmur kayymi. uvedin hu dela lishallem kelal, verachamana hu dekanseh, ki hechi denintereh letoreh.

Siman: hizzik, ma, vehemit, kelal. tenan: hannizzak vehammazzik betashlumin. bishlama leman deamar palga nizka mamona, hayeynu deshayech nizzak betashlumin. ella leman deamar palga nizka kenasa, hasheta delav dideh ka shakel, betashlumin iteh?!
Lo nitzrecha ella lifchat nevela. pechat nevela, tenena: tashlume nezek — melammed shehabbealim mittappelin bannevela!
Chada betam vachada bemuad. utzericha, dei ashmoinan tam: mishshum deakkatti la iyyaad, aval muad deiyyaad — ema la. vei ashmoinan muad: mishshum deka meshallem kulleh, aval tam — ema la. tzericha.
Ta shema: ma ben tam lemuad, shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo, umuad meshallem nezek shalem min haaliyyay. vela katane shehattam eno meshallem al pi atzmo, umuad meshallem al pi atzmo.
Tena veshayyayr: may shayyer dehay shayyayr! shayyayr chatzi chofer. i mishshum chatzi chofer — lav shiyyura hu,
b: Ha manni rabbi yose haggelili hi, deamar: tam meshallem chatzi chofer.
Ta shema: "hemit shori et peloni", o "shoro shel peloni", hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo. may lav, betam! la, bemuad.

Aval betam may, eno meshallem al pi atzmo? addetane sefa: avdo shel peloni eno meshallem al pi atzmo, niflog venitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — bemuad, aval tam — eno meshallem al pi atzmo! kulla bemuad kamayyre.

Ta shema, ze hakkelal: kol hameshallem yater al ma shehizzik — eno meshallem al pi atzmo. ha pachot mimma shehizzik — meshallem al pi atzmo. la tema ha pachot mimma shehizzik, ella ema: ha kema shehizzik — meshallem al pi atzmo.
Aval pachot may, eno meshallem al pi atzmo? litne, ze hakkelal: kol sheeno meshallem kema shehizzik — eno meshallem al pi atzmo, demashma pachot umashma yater! teyuveta.

Vehilcheta: palga nizka kenasa. teyuveta vehilcheta?! in: tama may ittotav — mishshum dela katane "kema shehizzik", la pesika leh. kevan deikka chatzi nezek tzerorot, dehilcheta gemiri la demamona hu, mishshum hachi la katane.
Vehasheta deamrat palga nizka kenasa, hay kalba deachel immere, veshunnara deachel tarnegole ravreve, meshunne hu, vela magbenan bevavel. aval zutere — orcheh hu umagbenan.
Vei tefas — la mappekinan minneh. vei amar: akbeu li zimna leeretz yisrael — makbeinan leh. vei la azel — meshammetinan leh.

Ben kach uven kach meshammetinan leh. deamrinan leh: sallek hezzekach, midderabbi natan. detanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin shello yegaddel adam kelev ra betoch beto, velo yaamid sullam raua betoch beto, shenneemar: "velo tasim damim bevetecha".
Hadaran alach ellu nearot
Naara shennitpatteta — boshtah ufegamah ukenasah shel aviha, vehatztzaar bitfusa. amda baddin ad shello met haav — hare hen shel av. met haav — hare hen shel achin.

Lo hispika laamod baddin ad shemmet haav — hare hen shel atzmah, amda baddin ad shello bagra — hare hen shel av, met haav — hare hen shel achin. lo hispika laamod baddin ad shebbagra — hare hen shel atzmah. rabbi shimon omer: im lo hispika ligbot ad shemmet haav — hare hen shel atzmah,

a: Maase yadeha umetziatah, af al pi shello gavta, met haav — hare hen shel achin.

Gemara may ka mashma lan? tenena: hamefatte noten shelosha devarim, vehaones arbaa. hamefatte noten boshet ufegam ukenas, mosif alav ones shennoten et hatztzaar! leaviha itzterich leh. leaviha name peshita, middeka yahev mefatte, dei leatzmah — ammay yahev mefatte? middatah avad!
Amda baddin itztericha leh, pelugeta derabbi shimon verabbanan.
Tenan hatam: "anasta ufittita et bitti", vehu omer: "lo anasti velo pittiti". "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen", veachar kach hoda — chayyayv.
Rabbi shimon poter, sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo. amru lo: af al pi sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo, aval meshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo.

Bea minneh abbaye merabba, haomer lachavero: "anasta ufittita et bitti, veheemadticha baddin, venitchayyayvta li mamon", vehu omer: "lo anasti velo pittiti, velo heemadtani baddin, velo nitchayyayvti lecha mamon", venishba vehoda, lerabbi shimon may?
Kevan deamad baddin — mamona havey, umichayyayv aleh korban shevua. o dilma, af al gav deamad baddin, kenas have? amar leh: mamona have, umichayyayv aleh korban shevua.

Etiveh, rabbi shimon omer: yachol haomer lachavero "anasta ufittita et bitti", vehu omer: "lo anasti velo pittiti"; "hemit shorcha et avdi", vehu omer: "lo hemit"; o sheamar lo avdo "hippalta et shinni vesimita et eni", vehu omer: "lo hippalti velo simiti", venishba vehoda, yachol yehe chayyayv —

Talmud lomar: "vechichesh baamito befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel o ashak et amito. o matza aveda vechichesh bah venishba al shaker", ma ellu meyuchadin shehen mamon, af kol shehen mamon. yatzu ellu, shehen kenas.
b: May lav besheamad baddin! la, beshello amad baddin.

Veha midderesha besheamad baddin, sefa name besheamad baddin. dekatane resha: en li ella devarim shemmeshallemin alehem et hakkeren. tashlume chefel, tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vehaones vehamefatte umotzi shem ra, minnayin — talmud lomar: "umaala maal", ribba.
Hechi dame? i delo amad baddin, kefela mi ikka? ella peshita besheamad baddin. umidderesha besheamad baddin, sefa name besheamad baddin!

Amar leh, yachelna leshannoye lach: resha besheamad baddin, vesefa beshello amad baddin, vechulla rabbi shimon hi. veshinnuye dechike la meshannenan lach. deim ken amrat li: litne resha "rabbi shimon omer", o litne sefa "divre rabbi shimon".
Ella: kulla besheamad baddin, veresha rabbanan vesefa rabbi shimon.
Umodena lach leinyan korban shevua derachamana patreh, mivvechichesh".
Vechi kaamena mamon have — lehorisho levanav.
Etiveh, rabbi shimon omer: im lo hispika ligbot ad shemmet haav — hare hen shel atzmah. vei amrat mamon have lehorisho levanav, leatzmah ammay? deachin bae mihve!

Amar rava: hay milleta keshay ba rabba verav yosef esrin vetarten shenin vela ipperak, ad ditev rav yosef beresha ufayrka: shane hatam, deamar kera: "venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kesef", lo zikketa tora laav ella mishsheat netina.
Vechi kaamar rabba mamona have lehorisho levanav — bishar kenasot.
Ella meatta gabbe eved, dichtiv: "kesef sheloshim shekalim yitten ladonav", hachi name lo zikketa tora laadon ella mishsheat netina?! "yitten" lechud, "venatan" lechud.
I hachi, talmud lomar: "vechichesh"? talmud lomar: "venatan" mibbee leh!
Amar rava: ki itzterich "vechichesh" — kegon sheamda baddin, uvagra umeta. dehatam, ki ka yaret aviha — minna dida ka yaret.
I hachi, "yatzu ellu shehen kenas", mamon hu! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: yatzu ellu sheikkaran kenas.
Etiveh: rabbi shimon poter, sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo. tama delo amad baddin, ha amad baddin, dimshallem al pi atzmo, korban shevua name michayyayv!
Rabbi shimon ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi, af al gav deamad baddin — rachamana patreh mivvechichesh". ella ledidchu, odo li mihat hecha delo amad baddin, dechi ka tava, kenasa ka tava,

a: Umode biknas patur. verabbanan savri, ki ka tava — boshet ufegam ka tava.

Bemay ka mippalgi? amar rav pappa, rabbi shimon savar: la shavek inish midde dekitz, vetava midde dela kitz. verabbanan savri: la shavek inish midde dechi mode beh la mippetar, vetava midde dechi mode beh mippetar.
Bea minneh rabbi avina merav sheshet: bat hannizzonet min haachin — maase yadeha lemi?
Bimkom av kayymi, ma hatam — maase yadeha laav, hacha name — maase yadeha laachin, o dilma: la dame leav. hatam — middideh mittazna, hacha — lav middidhu mittazna.
Amar leh, tenetuha: almana nizzonet minnichse yetomim umaase yadeha shellahen.
Mi dame? almenato, la nicha leh beharevavcha. bitto, nicha leh beharevocha.
Lememra devitto adifa leh mealmenato? vehaamar rabbi abba amar rabbi yose: asu almana etzel habbat kabbat etzel achin binchasin muatin,

Ma habbat etzel achin — habbat nizzonet, vehaachin yishalu al happetachim, af almana etzel habbat — almana nizzonet, vehabbat tishal al happetachim. leinyan ziluta — almenato adifa leh. leinyan harevavcha — bitto adifa leh.
Metiv rav yosef: maase yadeha umetziatah, af al pi shello gavta — met haav hare hen shel achin. tama divchayye haav, ha leachar mitat haav — leatzmah. may lav benizzonet? la, besheenah nizzonet.
I besheenah nizzonet, may lememra? afillu leman deamar yachol harav lomar laeved "ase immi veeni zanach". hane mille beeved kenaani, dela ketiv beh "immach".
Aval eved ivri dichtiv beh "immach" — lo. kol shekken bitto!
Amar rabba bar ulla: lo nitzrecha ella lehaadafa. amar rava: gavra rabba kerav yosef la yada deikka haadafa, vekamotev teyuveta?
Ella amar rava: rav yosef matnitin gufa kashya leh. dekatane: maase yadeha umetziatah, af al pi shello gavta. metziatah mimman gavya?

Ella lav, hachi kaamar: maase yadeha kimtziatah, ma metziatah bechayye haav — laav, leachar mitat haav — leatzmah, af maase yadeha name: bechayye haav — laav, leachar mitat haav — leatzmah. shema minna.

Ittemar name, amar rav yehuda amar rav: bat hannizzonet min haachin, maase yadeha leatzmah. amar rav kahana: may tama — dichtiv: "vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem". "otam livnechem", velo benotechem livnechem. maggid sheen adam morish zechut bitto livno.
Matkef la rabba: veema befittuy habbat ukenasot vachavalot hakkatuv medabber. vechen tana rav chanina: befittuy habbat ukenasot vachavalot hakkatuv medabber!
Chavalot, tzaara degufa ninhu. amar rabbi yose bar chanina:
b: Sheppetzaah befaneha. amar rav zera amar rav matna amar rav, veamri la, amar rabbi zera amar rav matna amar rav: bat hannizzonet min haachin maase yadeha leatzmah, dichtiv: "vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem". "otam livnechem", velo benotechem livnechem. maggid sheen adam morish zechut bitto livno.

Amar leh avimi bar pappe: shakud amra. shakud mannu? shemuel, ha rav amra! ema: af shakud amra. amar mar bar ammemar lerav ashe: hachi amri nehardae: hilcheta kevoteh derav sheshet. rav ashe amar: hilcheta kevoteh derav, vehilcheta kevoteh derav.

Mishna hameares et bitto vegershah, ersah venitarmela — ketubbatah shello. hissiah vegershah, hissiah venitarmela — ketubbatah shellah. rabbi yehuda omer: harishona shel av. amru lo: im mishshehissiah, en leaviha reshut bah.
Gemara tama dehissiah vegershah, hissiah venitarmela, aval nitarmela tere zimne — tu la chazya leinnesove. veaggav orcheh ka satem lan tanna kerabbi, deamar: bitre zimne havya chazaka.
Rabbi yehuda omer: harishona shel av. may tama derabbi yehuda? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: hoil umishsheat erusin zacha bahen haav.

Metiv rava, rabbi yehuda omer: harishona shel av. umode rabbi yehuda bimares et bitto keshehi ketanna uvagra, veachar kach nisset, sheen leaviha reshut bah. ammay? hacha name lema: hoil umishsheat erusin zacha bahen haav.
Ella, i ittemar, hachi ittemar: rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: hoil uvirshuto nichtavin.
Umigba, meemat gavya?
Amar rav huna: mane matayim min haerusin, vetosefet min hannissuin. verav assi amar: echad ze veechad ze min hannissuin.

Umi amar rav huna hachi? vehaittemar: hotzia alav shete ketubbot, achat shel matayim, veachat shel shelosh meot. veamar rav huna: bata ligbot matayim — gova mizzeman rishon, shelosh meot — gova mizzeman sheni.
Veim ita, tigbe matayim mizzeman rishon, umea mizzeman sheni.
Uletamaych, tigbe chamesh meot kullam? matayim mizzeman rishon, telat mea mizzeman sheni!

Ella chamesh meot may tama la gavya? kevan dela katav lah: "tzeveti veosefit lach telat mea ammatayim". hachi kaamar la: i mizzeman rishon gavyat — gevay matayim, i mizzeman sheni gavyat — gevay telat mea

a: Hacha name hayeynu tama dela gavya, middela ketav la "osefit lich mea ammatayim", achole achelteh leshibuda kamma.
Amar mar: i baaya — behay gavya, i baaya — behay gavya. lema peliga derav nachman? deamar rav nachman: shene shetarot hayyotzin beze achar ze — bittel sheni et harishon.
Lav mi ittemar ala, amar rav pappa: umode rav nachman dei osef beh dikla, letosefet katveh. hacha name, ha osef la midde!

Gufa. amar rav nachman: shene shetarot hayyotzin beze achar ze — bittel sheni et harishon. amar rav pappa: umode rav nachman dei osef beh dikla — letosefet katveh. peshita rishon bemecher vesheni bemattana, leyappot kocho hu dichtav leh — mishshum dina devar mitzra.
Vechol shekken rishon bemattana vesheni bemecher, deamrinan mishshum dina devaal chov hu dichtav ken.
Ella i shenehem bemecher shenehem bemattana bittel sheni et harishon. may tama? rafram amar: emar odoye odi leh. rav acha amar: emar achole achleh leshibudeh.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu: oroe sahade.
Uleshallome pere uletaska.
May have ala dichtubba? ta shema, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: mane matayim min haerusin, vetosefet min hannissuin.
Vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze min hannissuin. vehilcheta: echad ze veechad ze min hannissuin.
Mishna haggiyyoret shennitgayyeyra bittah immah vezinneta — hare zo bechenek, en lah lo petach bet haav, velo mea sela.
Hayta horatah shello bikdushsha veledatah bikdushsha — hare zo biskila, veen lah lo petach bet haav, velo mea sela. hayta horatah veledatah bikdushsha, hare hi kevat yisrael lechol devareha.
Yesh lah av veen lah petach bet haav, yesh lah petach bet haav veen lah av — hare zo biskila. lo neemar petach bet av ella lemitzva.
b: Gemara mena hane mille? amar resh lakish, deamar kera "vameta", lerabbot horatah shello bikdushsha veledatah bikdushsha.
I hachi milka name nilke, umea sela name leshallem! amar kera "vameta" — lemita nitrabbeta velo liknas. veema lerabbot horatah veledatah bikdushsha? hahi yisreelit meallayyta hi.
Veema lerabbot horatah veledatah shello bikdushsha! im ken, "beyisrael" may ahani leh.
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: hammotzi shem ra al hayyetoma patur, shenneemar: "venatnu laavi hannaara" — perat lezo sheen lah av.
Metiv rabbi yose bar avin, veittema rabbi yose bar zevida: "veim maen yemaen aviha" — lerabbot yetoma liknas, divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: bava aleha veachar kach nityattema.
Rava amar: chayyayv. mimmay — middetane amme: betulat yisrael, velo betulat gerim.
I amrat bishlama ki hay gavvna beyisrael michayyayv, hayeynu deitzterich kera lemaote gerim. ella i amrat beyisrael kehay gavvna patur, hasheta beyisrael patur, begerim mibbaya?!
Amar resh lakish: hammotzi shem ra al hakketanna — patur, shenneemar: "venatnu laavi hannaara", "naara" male dibber hakkatuv.

Matkef la rav acha bar abba: tama dichtiv ba "hannaara", ha lav hachi hava amena afillu ketanna?! ha ketiv: "veim emet haya haddavar hazze lo nimtzeu vetulim lannaara. vehotziu et hannaara el petach bet aviha usekaluha", uketanna lav bat onashin hi!
Ella: kan "naara", ha kol makom shenneemar "naara" — afillu ketanna bammashma.
Tane shela: shalosh middot bannaara: bau lah edim bevet chamiha shezzinneta bevet aviha —

a: Soklin otah al petach bet aviha, kelomar: reu giddulim sheggiddaltem. bau lah edim bevet aviha shezzinneta bevet aviha — soklin otah al petach shaar hair. sarcha ulevassof bagra — tiddon bechenek.

Lememra dechol hecha deishtanni gufa ishtanni ketala? ureminhi: naara hameorasa shezzinneta, umishshebbagra hotzi aleha shem ra hu eno loke, veeno noten mea sela, hi vezommeha makdimin levet hassekila.
Hi vezommeha salka datach?! ella: o hi o zommeha makdimin levet hassekila.
Amar rava: motzi shem ra kaamrat? shane motzi shem ra dechiddush hu, deha nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala, bealma, vezinneta — bechenek, veillu motzi shem ra — biskila.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: dilma ki chaddet rachamana hecha dela ishtanni gufa, aval hecha deishtanni gufa, la chaddet rachamana!
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ishtanni vela ishtanni, tannae hi, ditnan: chatu ad shello nitmannu, venitmannu, hare hen kehedyotot.
Rabbi shimon omer: im noda lahem ad shello nitmannu — chayyayvim, mishshennitmannu — peturim.
b: Emor deshaminan leh lerabbi shimon deazel af batar yedia, deazel batar yedia vela azel batar cheta mi shamat leh? im ken — layyte korban ki dehashta: mashuach par, venasi sair!
Haamar leh rabbi yochanan letanna: teni, tiddon biskila. veammay? "naara hameorasa" amar rachamana veha bogeret hi! amar rabbi ila, amar kera: "hannaara" — hannaara shehayta kevar.
Amar leh rabbi chananya lerabbi ila: i hachi milka name lilke, umea sela name lishallem! amar leh: rachamana naytztzelan mehay data: adderabba, rachamana naytztzelan middata didach.

Vetama may? amar rabbi yitzchak bar avin, veittema rabbi yitzchak bar abba: zo maaseha garmu lah, veze akimat sefatav garmu lo. zo maaseha garmu lah, (keshehi) [ki] zannay — [keshehi] naara zannay. veze akimat sefatav garmu lo, emat ka michayyayv? hahi shata, vehahi shata bogeret havay.

Tanu rabbanan: naara hameorasa shezzinneta — soklin otah al petach bet aviha. en lah petach bet haav, soklin otah al petach shaar hair hahi. uveir sherubbah goyim — soklin otah al petach bet din. kayyotze baddavar atta omer: haoved avoda zara — soklin oto al shaar sheavad bo, uveir sherubbah goyim — soklin oto al petach bet din.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "shearecha", ze shaar sheavad bo. atta omer shaar sheavad bo, o eno ella shaar shenniddon bo?
Neemar "shearecha" lematta, veneemar "shearecha" lemala. ma "shearecha" haamur lemala — shaar sheavad bo, af "shearecha" haamur lematta — shaar sheavad bo.
Davar acher: "shearecha", velo shaare goyim. hay "shearecha", ha appekteh? im ken, lema kera "shaar", may "shearecha"? shema minna tarte.
Ashkechan avoda zara, naara hameorasa mena lan?
Amar rabbi avahu: gamar "petach" mippetach", ufetach" mishshaar", veshaar" mishshearecha".
Tanu rabbanan: hammotzi shem ra loke venoten mea sela. rabbi yehuda omer: lilkot — loke mikkol makom, mea sela, baal — noten, lo baal — eno noten.

Ka mippalgi biflugeta derabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbanan. vehachi kaamar: hammotzi shem ra — loke venoten mea sela, ben baal ben shello baal, kerabbanan. rabbi yehuda omer: lilkot — loke mikkol makom, mea sela, baal — noten, lo baal — eno noten, kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
Ikka deamri: kulla kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. vehachi kaamar: hammotzi shem ra — loke venoten mea sela, vehu shebbaal. rabbi yehuda omer: lilkot — loke mikkol makom.
Vesavar rabbi yehuda lilkot loke mikkol makom? vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: baal — loke, lo baal — eno loke! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: loke makkat mardut midderabbanan.

a: Rav pappa amar: may "baal loke" dekatane hatam — mamon. vekare leh lemamon malkot? in, veha tenan: "haomer chatzi erki alay" — noten chatzi erko. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: loke venoten erech shalem. loke ammay? amar rav pappa: loke beerech shalem.
May tama — gezera "chatzi erko" attu "erech chetzyo". veerech chetzyo" have leh ever shehanneshama teluya bo.
Tanu rabbanan: "veanshu oto" — ze mamon, "veyisseru" — ze malkot.
Bishlama "veanshu" ze mamon, dichtiv "veanshu oto mea chesef venatnu laavi hannaara". ella "veyisseru" ze malkot — menalan?
Amar rabbi avahu: lamadnu "yisseru" miyyisseru", veyisseru" mibben", uven" mibbin" — "vehaya im bin hakkot harasha".
Azhara lemotzi shem ra menalan? rabbi elazar amar: millo telech rachil". rabbi natan omer: mivvenishmarta mikkol davar ra".
