Verabbi elazar may tama la amar mehay? hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi pinchas ben yair. "venishmarta mikkol davar ra", mikkan amar rabbi pinchas ben yair: al yeharher adam bayyom veyavo lide tumea ballayla.
Verabbi natan may tama la amar mehay? hahu: azhara levet din shello yehe rach laze vekashe laze.
Lo amar leedim "bou vehaiduni", vehen meidim oto mealehen — hu eno loke, veeno noten mea selaim. hi vezommeha makdimin levet hassekila.
Hi vezommeha salka datach?! ella: o hi o zommeha makdimin levet hassekila.
Tama dela amar lehu, ha amar lehu, af al gav dela agrinhu. leappoke midderabbi yehuda. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: eno chayyayv ad sheyyiskor edim.
May tama derabbi yehuda? amar rabbi avahu: atya "sima" "sima". ketiv hacha: "vesam lah alilot devarim", uchetiv hatam: "lo tesimun alav neshech", ma lehallan mamon, af kan mamon.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, vechen tane rav yosef tzidoni be rabbi shimon ben yochay: atya "sima" "sima".
Bae rabbi yirmeya: secharan bekarka, mahu? befachot mishshave peruta, mahu? shenehem bifruta, mahu?
Bae rav ashe: hotzi shem ra al hannissuin harishonim, mahu? al nissue achiv, mahu?
Peshot miha chada. detane rabbi yona: "et bitti natatti laish hazze". leze — velo layyavam.
May rabbanan umay rabbi eliezer ben yaakov? detanya: ketzad hotzaat shem ra? ba levet din, veamar: peloni, lo matzati levittecha betulim. im yesh edim shezzinneta tachtav — yesh lah ketubba mane.
Im yesh edim shezzinneta tachtav yesh lah ketubba mane?! bat sekila hi! hachi kaamar: im yesh edim shezzinneta tachtav — biskila. zinneta meikkara, yesh lah ketubba mane.

Nimtza (she)shem ra [she]eno shem ra — hu loke venoten mea sela, ben baal uven lo baal. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: lo neemru devarim hallalu ella keshebbaal. bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, hayeynu dichtiv: "uva eleha", "vaekrav eleha",
Ella lerabbanan, may "uva eleha", "vaekrav eleha"? "uva eleha" — baalilot, "vaekrav eleha" — bidvarim.
Bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov hayeynu dichtiv: "lo matzati levittecha betulim". ella lerabbanan, may "lo matzati levittecha betulim"! lo matzati levittecha keshere vetulim.
Bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, hayeynu dichtiv "veelle betule vitti". ella lerabbanan, may "veelle betule vitti"? veelle keshere betule vitti.
Bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, hayeynu dichtiv: "ufarsu hassimla". ella lerabbanan, may "ufarsu hassimla"?

Amar rabbi avahu: parsu ma shessam lah. kidtanya: "ufarsu hassimla", melammed shebbain edim shel ze veedim shel ze, uvorrin et haddavar kesimla chadasha. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: devarim kichtavan, simla mammash.

Shalach rabbi yitzchak bar rav yaakov bar giyyore mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: af al gav shello matzinu bechol hattora kullah shechillek hakkatuv ben bia kedarkah levia shello kedarkah lemakkot velaonashin, aval motzi shem ra chillek: eno chayyayv ad sheyyivol shello kedarkah, veyotzi shem ra kedarkah.
Keman? i kerabbanan, af al gav dela baal. i kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov,
b: Idde veidde kedarkah baenan! ella shelach rav kahana mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: eno chayyayv ad sheyyivol kedarkah, veyotzi shem ra bichdarkah.
Mishna haav zakkay bevitto bekiddusheha bechesef, bishtar, uvevia. zakkay bimtziatah, uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha, umekabbel et gittah. veeno ochel perot bechayyeha.
Nisset — yater alav habbaal, sheochel perot bechayyeha, vechayyayv bimzonoteha, uvefirkonah, ukevuratah. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu ani shebbeyisrael lo yifchot mishshene chalilin umekonenet.
Gemara bechesef menalan? amar rav yehuda: amar kera: "veyatza chinnam en kasef", en kesef leadon ze, veyesh kesef leadon acher, umannu? aviha.
Veema ledida! hasheta aviha mekabbel kiddusheha, dichtiv: "et bitti natatti laish hazze", ihi shakla kaspa?!
Veema hane mille ketanna, delet la yad. aval naara, deit la yad — ihi tekaddesh nafsha veihi tishkol kaspa! amar kera: "binureha bet aviha" — kol shevach neurim leaviha.

Veella ha deamar rav huna amar rav: minnayin shemmaase habbat leaviha, shenneemar: "vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama", ma ama maase yadeha lerabbah — af bat maase yadeha leaviha. lema li? tippok leh mibbinureha bet aviha"! ella: hahu bahafarat nedarim hu dichtiv.
Vechi tema nelaf minna — mamona meissura la yalfinan. vechi tema nelaf mikkenasa — mamona mikkenasa la yalfinan.
Vechi tema nelaf mibboshet ufegam — shane boshet ufegam deaviha name shayech beh.
Ella, mistabbera dechi memaet rachamana — yetzia dichvota ka memaet.
Veha la damya ha yetzia leha yetzia: hatam, gabbe adon, nafka la mershuteh ligmare, yetzia deav — akkatti mechassera mesira lechuppa!
Mehafarat nedarim miha nafka la mershuteh, ditnan: naara hameorasa aviha uvalah mefirin lah nedareha.
Shetar uvia mena lan? amar kera: "vehayta leish acher", ittakkush havoyot lahadade.
Zakkay bimtziatah —
